Corollary
[Closedness of the cut locus] ↗ prop:dc-ch13-2-9 1. ch13:2.10For all $p\in M$, $C_m(p)$ is closed; in particular, if $M$ is compact, $C_m(p)$ is compact.
Proof

\sketch One verifies $C_m(p)=\{ \gamma (t);t=f(p,\gamma '(0))\} $, where $f$ is the function of section 1. If $q$ is an accumulation point of $C_m(p)$, take $\gamma _j(t_j)\to q$ with $t_j=f(p,\gamma _j'(0))$ and $\gamma _j'(0)\to v$. With $\gamma (0)=p$, $\gamma '(0)=v$, continuity of $f$ gives $q=\exp _p(f(p,\gamma '(0))\gamma '(0))=\gamma (f(p,\gamma '(0)))\in C_m(p)$.

□
